name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Tree.path_expansion
title: Tree-encoding path expansion: one-step expansion identities compose along a root-to-leaf path
statement: In any ring (for matrices of different shapes, after zero-padding to square matrices), if H_j P_j - Z Q_j = H_{j+1} for every j (one expansion step of Equation (13) of Tree Encodings I, with H_j = h_{alpha<j}^T (x) G the encoding matrix of the j-th digest on the path, P_j = P_{alpha_j} and Q_j = Q_{y_{alpha<j}, alpha_j}), and K_0 = 0, K_{j+1} = K_j P_j + Q_j, then H_0 (P_0 P_1 ... P_{d-1}) - Z K_d = H_d. This is the induction (16) in the proof of Lemma 7 of Abram-Malavolta-Roy (ePrint 2026/741), with the sign of Q absorbed.
